        echo '[$(date)] Starting eval: $NAME on GPU $GPU port $PORT'
        echo '[$(date)] Checkpoint: $CKPT_DIR'

            --policy.dir $CKPT_DIR &
        SERVER_PID=\$!
        echo \"[$(date)] Server PID: \$SERVER_PID\"

        echo '[$(date)] Waiting 90s for server startup...'

            --suite safelibero_object --safety_level II \
            --n_episodes 200 --max_steps 300 --replan_steps 5 --seed 7 \

        kill \$SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true
        wait \$SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true
        echo '[$(date)] Done.'
    "

done

echo "All 4 eval sessions launched."
